name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
steps: Face away from the Smith bar at thigh height and grasp it behind your hips with palms facing back.
Release the hooks, stand tall and steady your upper arms at your sides.
Let your wrists extend slightly, then flex them to draw your knuckles toward the backs of your forearms.
Lower the bar slowly back to full wrist extension under control before reracking when finished.
tips: Keep your elbows straight and shoulders stationary so your forearm flexors do all the work.
Keep your thumbs wrapped and choose a range that lets you control the bar.
